about: E106: direct 0-credit Pavo probes of talking clips, one entry per LINE (PR #419, evidence/pavo/20261026/keeper-line-length.json: the lips pass rate depends on the line itself, line-01 7 of 14 against genesis-07's Keeper lines 1 of 39 under the same speaker, reference, pose and binding; it is not one rate per setup). An entry is the speaker, the reference images the request sends for the speaker (record id -> sha256), the prompt binding (episode_build.BOUND_AUDIO) and the line's words; generations / passed are lipsync_check passes (thresholds unchanged) over direct calls on exactly that. episode_preflight.probe_rows matches a talking shot on all four: a line with no entry is PROBE_REQUIRED even when its speaker's setup passed on another line, and a recorded rate whose chance at TALK_ATTEMPTS is under MIN_SHOT_CHANCE is PROBE_RATE_LOW. New entries come by PR with their evidence file. A voice-over Keeper shot (plan B, #423) speaks nothing on screen: it is matched as kind still_mouth on speaker, his talking frame (the only reference it sends) and its exact prompt (the gaze and the light decide whether the landmarker finds the face, keeper-vo/calibration.json), and judged by lipsync_check --still-mouth.
